latest_release.name: Release 2.1.1
latest_release.body:
This is the 2.1.1 release of gRPC-Web! :)

Please see the notes for the previous releases [here](https://github.com/grpc/grpc-web/releases). Please consult [grpc.io](https://grpc.io/) for all information regarding this product.

This release contains improvements and bug fixes listed below.

### Security

- [#1547](https://github.com/grpc/grpc-web/pull/1547) limit maxReceiveMessageSize to 4MB to have parity with other runtimes @mbissa 

### Other Changes

- [#1548](https://github.com/grpc/grpc-web/pull/1548) fix(docker): resolve grpcwebproxy build failure caused by dead vanity ... @Vuhag123
- [#1545](https://github.com/grpc/grpc-web/pull/1545) chore: upgrade macOS CI to macos-14 and prune unused rollup-plugin-cop... @Vuhag123

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/grpc/grpc-web/compare/2.1.0...2.1.1
